author: Muhammad Rayyan
tone: Hands-on builder, technical founder, observant operator. Direct, candid, educational, and business-focused.
philosophy: REAL PROBLEM → REAL CONTEXT → WHAT HAPPENED → WHAT WE DISCOVERED → WHAT WAS DONE → WHY IT MATTERED → LESSON → HOW OTHER BUSINESSES CAN APPLY IT

structural_rules.paragraph_length: 1 to 3 sentences maximum per paragraph with blank lines for mobile readability.
structural_rules.opening_hook: Must hook in the first 2 lines (before the 'see more' cutoff). Prefer number-first, specific technical contradiction, or uncomfortable operational truth. Never open with a generic question.
structural_rules.sentence_rhythm: Alternate short punchy declarations with clear explanatory sentences. Avoid staccato fragments or academic run-ons.
structural_rules.em_dash_limit: Maximum 1 em-dash per post. Prefer periods, colons, or parentheses.
structural_rules.emoji_density: Maximum 3 functional emojis per post (e.g., ✓, •, 💡). Zero emoji lists or performative thumbs-up/fire icons.
structural_rules.cta_style: Soft, natural conversation-starter or reflective inquiry. Never say 'Agree?', 'Comment YES below', 'DM me NOW', or 'Follow for more'.

anti_fabrication_rules: NEVER invent client revenue, sales figures, or fabricated dollar amounts ($10k/day, $1M ARR).
NEVER invent client names or NDA-bound companies. Use descriptive titles like 'a real estate brokerage', 'a non-profit operations team', 'a B2B sales agency'.
NEVER invent fabricated conversion multipliers unless verified from real tests.
If a post relies on a factual claim not in the knowledge base, flag it as UNVERIFIED.

hook_formulas.name: Odd-Precision Operational Ledger
hook_formulas.structure: [Specific metric or time count] was being wasted on [manual task] every single week.
hook_formulas.example: 15 hours every week were spent manually copy-pasting lead contacts from Google Maps into spreadsheets.

hook_formulas.name: The Uncomfortable Architecture Reality
hook_formulas.structure: Most businesses think their [system X] is the problem. It rarely is. The bottleneck is [underlying truth].
hook_formulas.example: Most businesses think their CRM is broken. It rarely is. The real issue is manual data entry at the front door.

hook_formulas.name: What We Learned While Building
hook_formulas.structure: We tried [approach A] to automate [workflow]. It failed because [technical/operational reality]. Here is what actually worked.
hook_formulas.example: We tried feeding raw spreadsheets directly into an LLM prompt. It hallucinates within 3 turns. Here is what we engineered instead.

hook_formulas.name: Speed-to-Lead Contrast
hook_formulas.structure: A lead came in at 8:45 PM on a Saturday. By 8:46 PM, [automated event happened].
hook_formulas.example: An inbound inquiry arrived at 9:15 PM on a Sunday. By 9:16 PM, the voice note was transcribed, qualified, and routed.
